clips.title: The story
paras: Seer Ravenfeather is a tauren shaman instructor stationed at Camp Narache on the Red Cloud Mesa. She guides fledging spiritualists through their early trials, helping them attune to the voices of the spirits and the land of Mulgore.

Standing within the quiet shelters of Camp Narache, Seer Ravenfeather serves as a patient teacher for young tauren called to walk the shamanic path. The Red Cloud Mesa is a sacred proving ground, and Ravenfeather ensures that novice practitioners understand their duties before venturing into the wider expanses of Mulgore. She instructs them in the foundational rites needed to commune with elemental forces and honor the Earth Mother.

Ravenfeather's primary charge is overseeing the initial spiritual steps of nascent shamans, directing them in the traditional rite known as the Call of Earth. Through her guidance, initiates prepare ceremonial saptas and seek communion with the earthen spirits nestled within the mesa's stony outcrops, forging a bond that anchors their elemental magic.
